THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S.438 CR.P.C PRAYING TO ENLARGE THE PETITIONER ON BAIL IN THE EVENT OF THEOR ARREST IN CR.NO.32/2023 OF MALEBENNUR P.S.,
DAVANAGERE FOR THE OFFENCE P/U/S.498-A, 307, 34 OF IPC PENDING ON THE FILE OF 2ND ADDITIONAL CIVIL JUDGE AND JMFC COURT HARIHARA, DAVANAGERE.

THIS PETITION IS COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:

ORDER Petitioners are accused Nos.1 and 2 respectively in Cr.No.32/2023 of Malebennur police station,
Davanagere District.
The said case is registered for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 307 r/w 34 of IPC on a complaint given by one Thimmeshi S/o Manjappa.
2. It is the case of prosecution that victim Roopa was given in marriage to one Bharamagouda of Hosapalu village, Harihara Taluk about 14-15 years prior.
Petitioners are the mother-in-law and sister-in-law of complainant's sister Roopa.
It is alleged that they were giving physical and mental torture to her and in this regard several panchayats were held.

On 13.02.2023 at about 7.00 p.m.
when the victim was preparing vada, the NC: 2023:KHC:19889 petitioners poured hot oil on her face and other parts of the body with an intention of taking away her life.
3. The material on record would reveal that these two petitioners have shifted the victim to the Government Hospital, Harihara.
From there, she was shifted to S.S. Hospital, Davanagere by her husband.
As per the wound certificate, the victim has sustained burn injuries on her face, neck etc.
The injuries are stated to be grievous in nature.
The history given is "burn at home".
However, it is not alleged that the burn injuries are caused by the petitioners.

The contention of the learned counsel for petitioners is that a false case has been foisted against the petitioners on account of some family dispute and if there was any intention on the part of the petitioners as alleged by the prosecution, to take the life of the victim, they would not have shifted her to the hospital.
There is some force in the said contention.
The statement of the victim is already recorded.
Petitioner No.1 is an aged woman.
It is submitted that petitioner No.2 is already NC: 2023:KHC:19889 married and living separately.
The victim has been discharged from the hospital.

Hence, the following:

sentences.text: Petition is allowed.

2. The petitioner shall be released in the event of their arrest in Cr.No.32/2023 of Malebennur police station, Davanagere District, subject to following conditions:
(1) Petitioners/accused Nos.1 and 2 shall appear before the Investigation Officer within a period of one week from the date of receipt of a certified copy of the order and shall execute a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- [Rupees fifty thousand only] with two sureties for the likesum.
(2) Petitioners shall cooperate with the investigation and they shall not tamper with the prosecution witnesses either directly or indirectly.
NC: 2023:KHC:19889 (3) Petitioners shall not try to influence, induce or threaten the victim in any manner.
(4) Petitioners shall furnish proof of their residential address and shall inform the Investigation Officer/Court regarding change in the address, if any.
(5) Petitioners shall be regular in attending the Court proceedings.

SD/-
